verdict.rationale: Datalab documents page-level limits with a workaround (page_range) for large documents, per-processor billing, and Team-tier rate limits (400 req/min per datalab-supp-2), plus an Enterprise option explicitly targeting 'extremely high volume' customers (datalab-supp-1). However there's no dedicated bulk/batch ingestion API, no documented throughput benchmarks for millions of pages, and no independent evidence of sustained high-volume performance. Missing for 10: explicit batch-processing endpoint for large-scale jobs, published throughput/SLA numbers at millions-of-pages scale, and independent corroboration of predictable performance under heavy load.
